audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart (both layers) gave Vayne five of seven stages, contradicting both the packet chart [Vayne, Illaoi x5, Vayne] and the whys text, which already describes L2 onward as Illaoi's.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 53.76% over 1395 games. Test of Spirit reaches 900 against Vayne's 550 Condemn; a melee-range Vayne has no way to answer the spirit once it lands.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Vayne, Levels 2 through first item Illaoi, 2+ items Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were vague about which numbers create each window.
audit.why: Concrete spikes: Illaoi level 3 (E 900 vs Condemn 550, Condemn down 20s at rank 1), level 6 (Leap of Faith, 450 range, tentacle per champion hit), Iceborn Gauntlet. Vayne's real spike is item-based Silver Bolts %max-HP true damage, which ignores the armour Illaoi stacks.
audit.corrected: spikes[0]-[2] rewritten with the ranges and cooldowns; spikes[3] left as the accurate late-game flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places asserted that Condemn's knockback 'won't break the tether'. That is not in Riot's text and the kit files cannot confirm it; the pages stated it as fact.
audit.why: Test of Spirit breaks if 'the target gets too far from the spirit' — whether a 550-range Condemn knockback exceeds that distance is exactly the kind of thing the kit data does not answer. Asserting it either way is speculation.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0] and mid around what is verifiable: E outranges Condemn 900 to 550, Condemn is on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown costing 90 mana, Harsh Lesson is a 4s cooldown so you get repeated swings inside one Condemn cycle, and Tumble is a 300-unit hop plus an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text referred to Vayne as 'he'/'him' throughout.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun on a paying page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble's auto-attack reset was never flagged as a timing tell.
audit.why: The _missing list carries autoreset-burst-tell for this matchup: Vayne's damage comes on the reset auto after the hop, not on the hop itself.
suspectNames flagged 'Test of Spirit' in wants.you[0]; that is the correct Riot name for Illaoi's E — false positive.

edits.before: At L2 your E-tether starts gluing a melee-range Vayne for a trade.
edits.after: At L2 your E reaches 900; her Condemn answer only reaches 550.

edits.before: Late game her item spikes let her kite and shred, flipping it to Vayne.
edits.after: Late her Silver Bolts %max-HP true damage shreds the HP you stacked.

edits.before: Once you hit 3 you dominate: land Test of Spirit (E) and Vayne cannot escape the tether even with Tumble (Q), because her Condemn (E) knockback doesn't break your leash and killing the spirit costs her huge HP. W (Harsh Lesson) onto her to unload tentacle hits and she melts — she has no way to trade back a squishy melee-range Vayne.
edits.after: Once you hit 3 you dominate: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 while her only disengage, Condemn (E), reaches 550 and is down 20s at rank 1. Tumble (Q) is a 300-unit hop on a 6s cooldown and an auto-attack reset — the wind-up after the hop is the damage tell, so step in on it, Harsh Lesson (W) onto her, and let the tentacles unload.

edits.before: Leap of Faith (R) spawns a wall of tentacles she cannot kite; if you've already E-tethered her, the vessel spawns give you a guaranteed kill. Her Final Hour (R) invisibility on Tumble helps her run, but not through your tentacle field at point-blank.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R) spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, but it is only 450 range — you have to already be on her. Land E first, W the spirit, then R. Her Final Hour (R) grants invisibility only during Tumble, so it hides the escape, not the field she is standing in.

edits.before: Vayne spikes with her first item and can start kiting your tentacles with Silver Bolts %HP shred, but you're still ahead if you hit E first. Ward for jungle ganks she'll set up and keep her pinned to walls only when you have E ready.
edits.after: Vayne spikes on her first item, and Silver Bolts' every-third-hit %max-HP true damage cuts straight through the armour you stack. You are still ahead when the fight opens on your E — never start one while it is down for 12-16s.

edits.before: Vayne edges L1 with Silver Bolts (W) %HP true damage chipping you as you walk up, and Tumble (Q) spacing your early Q pokes. Respect her auto harass and wait for your spike.
edits.after: Vayne edges L1: Silver Bolts (W) costs nothing and its third hit is %max-HP true damage, and Tumble (Q) spaces your Q. Take the chip, farm the wave, and wait for level 2.

edits.before: From L2 onward the lane is yours: a landed Test of Spirit (E) glues a melee-range Vayne in place, and her Condemn (E) knockback won't break the tether, so W-into-tentacles obliterates her. At 6 your Leap of Faith (R) on a tethered Vayne is a free kill she cannot kite out of.
edits.after: From L2 the lane is yours: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 against her 550 Condemn, and every tentacle swings at the spirit while the damage echoes back to her. Harsh Lesson (W) is a 4s cooldown, so you land repeat swings inside a single 20s Condemn cycle.

edits.before: Land E on Vayne as he steps to farm, W-slam the spirit with every tentacle, and zone him off the wave while it ticks.
edits.after: Land E on Vayne as she steps to farm, W-slam the spirit with every tentacle, and zone her off the wave while it ticks.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Condemn and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Condemn and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Vayne carry threat 9.5/10.
edits.after: Winnable lane — difficulty 6/10, Vayne carry threat 9.5/10.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Her level 1 only — L2 to first item are yours. See the chart for the swing points.

notes: Removed an unverifiable claim that appeared twice on this page: that Condemn's knockback cannot break the Test of Spirit tether. Riot's text does not say so and the kit data cannot settle it. If the user knows the answer, it is worth restating explicitly, since it changes how safely you can commit. Level chart in both layers contradicted the packet chart and the whys narrative; repaired in matched pairs.
